value: CDM K1/K2 and the PDS data's USC offset are offsets from the PDS exec base and the USC code base. On iOS both bases are the same 64 KiB pipeline heap (a8/M2: 'The PDS exec base and USC code base are this heap'). J1 does not test this: its HALT sits in the terminate and context-store PDS slots, which run only on a context store, so J1 never executed it

item: where the bases come from on J81
value: the config heap-base words (+0x00..+0x28, the A8's layout; the firmware programs the PDS and USC base registers from them, inferred). Map the pipeline heap at the base those words hold (0x3_00000000 in blob f per the request) and use offsets into it. If the PDS and USC words differ, put the PDS programs in the PDS-base heap and the USC kernel in the USC-base heap
